text: “Here is Mr. Roach, Master Colin,” said Mrs. Medlock. The young Rajah turned and looked his servitor over—at least that was what the head gardener felt happened. “Oh, you are Roach, are you?” he said. “I sent for you to give you some very important orders.” “Very good, sir,” answered Roach, wondering if he was to receive instructions to fell all the oaks in the park or to transform the orchards into water-gardens. “I am going out in my chair this afternoon,” said Colin.
